fusions.name: Flick and Skip
fusions.desc: Flicks a tine that deals 4 damage. For 3 seconds after using it, you move 15% faster.

fusions.name: Bounding Thrust
fusions.desc: You spring up to 7 tiles to the target and thrust, dealing 14 damage, up to 2 times that at maximum range.

fusions.name: Flushed Out
fusions.desc: Carries you 7 tiles forward in one burst.

fusions.name: Bolt-Hole Reflex
fusions.desc: Your movement speed is permanently increased by 12%.
